task: Build a modern, immersive Spider-Man themed website with specialized web-based animations and multi-page routing.

styling.global_css: @import "tailwindcss"; @import "tw-animate-css"; @import "shadcn/tailwind.css"; @import "@fontsource-variable/geist"; @custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *)); @theme inline { --font-sans: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } :root { --background: oklch(0.08 0.02 285); --foreground: oklch(0.98 0.005 285); --primary: oklch(0.65 0.28 25); --primary-foreground: oklch(0.98 0 0); --secondary: oklch(0.20 0.05 285); --secondary-foreground: oklch(0.95 0.01 285); --border: oklch(0.25 0.02 285); } @layer base { * { @apply border-border outline-ring/50; } body { @apply bg-background text-foreground; } }

steps.name: create_navigation_and_layout
steps.prompt: Create a Navigation component (Header.tsx) with an id='nav'. Include links to Home, Suit Gallery, and About. Style it with a glassmorphism effect using bg-secondary/80 and backdrop-blur. Add a sticky position. Ensure it uses standard React routing components.
steps.input: Sticky header with Spidey-red branding and nav links.

steps.name: create_home_page
steps.prompt: Create Home.tsx (id='home'). Implement a hero section with a bold title 'SPIDER-VERSE'. Integrate a 'Web Marquee' component that animates SVG-based web patterns across the top and bottom of the hero section using infinite X-axis scrolling animations. Use bg-background and gradient text from primary to secondary.
steps.input: Hero section with web marquee, background using primary/secondary gradients.

steps.name: create_suit_gallery
steps.prompt: Create SuitGallery.tsx (id='suit-gallery'). This page should showcase different Spider-Man suits in a grid layout. Each card should have hover effects (scale-up). Use bg-card with border-primary. Include a filter section to sort by 'Classic', 'MCU', and 'Multiverse'.
steps.input: Interactive suit cards with hover effects.

steps.name: create_about_page
steps.prompt: Create About.tsx (id='about'). Add a section detailing Spider-Man's lore. Use a two-column layout: one for a striking image, one for typography. Use bg-secondary for the container and ensure responsiveness (stacked on mobile). Add subtle 'spider-web' border accents using CSS.

steps.name: compose_app_routing
steps.prompt: Update App.tsx to include React Router configuration. Wrap the components (Header, Home, SuitGallery, About) in a Main layout. Ensure proper routing to '/home', '/suit-gallery', and '/about'. Ensure the theme remains dark throughout.
